dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual symmetric narrowing from the mid-body section toward a slender posterior peduncle, exhibiting a high rate of convergence in the final third of the visible length.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Slight asymmetric bulge on the right lateral margin relative to the central axis, with a localized indentation immediately preceding the peduncle narrowing.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Medium-light grey median intensity across the dorsal plane; consistent with an immature or transitioning pigment phase.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, diffuse darker grey clusters distributed across the posterior dorsal surface, particularly flanking the dorsal ridge.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradients with low edge-acuity between the darker mottled patches and the primary grayscale baseline.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Distinct longitudinal linear mark visible on the right side of the dorsal ridge; multiple faint, parallel linear striations visible on the left mid-dorsal region.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Linear shadow-casting along the central dorsal axis indicating a raised, well-defined dorsal ridge structure.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Single prominent longitudinal rake mark or scratch on the posterior right dorsal quadrant.
